d: A scarecrow species with a straw-filled body, featuring a head made of bundled golden-straw with a stitched smile and small, dark, bead-like eyes. The build is lean and slender, dressed in a white long-sleeved button-down shirt under a charcoal black waistcoat, paired with a golden-brown necktie and matching charcoal black trousers and dress shoes. A stethoscope hangs around the neck, while thick hemp rope wraps around the wrists and ankles, and a small straw bird perches on the shoulder. BODY COLOR: golden-straw
